# Step-preserving maps transport finite traces

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> A map preserving each step of one process into another sends every finite course to a course with the same moves; the converse, endpoints included, holds exactly where every step from an image lifts from each configuration with that image.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Where a map f takes every step of P to a step of Q with the same move, every finite trace of P from s to t is a trace of Q from f s to f t with the same moves. Through a map q, the traces of Q from q s are exactly the images of the traces of P from s, endpoints included, for every s, exactly where q preserves every step and every step of Q from q s lifts to a step of P from s by the same move into the fiber of its target.

Canonical source: [GenerativeCore.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/GenerativeCore.lean)
